Authors declare these links with a few typed calls, and the SDK writes the files

addResult(a, {
  id: "R1", validates: ["C1"],
  produced_by: "posterior_contraction",
  evidence: "experiments/…/contraction.csv",
  locators: { kl_final:
    { column: "kl_divergence", row: "final" } },
});
addClaim(a, {
  id: "C1",
  statement: "Posterior contraction improves…",
  validator: { kind: "builtin", name: "monotonic",
    input: { result: "R1",
             series: ["kl_initial", "kl_final"] },
    params: { direction: "decreasing" } },
});
writeSubmission(a, "./out");
out/
  manifest.yml
  claims.yml
  results.yml
  datasets.yml
  SHA256SUMS
  .sdk/state.json
  • TypeScript and Python bindings, tested against one shared corpus
  • Checks structure only: every ID resolves, every path stays inside
  • Re-running rewrites the same bytes and keeps your own files
